analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price($79.28) vs SMA5/20/50($78.39/$73.77/$71.57): Short-term bullish, mid-term bullish bias confirmed + above
· SMA100/200($74.12/$63.05) relative position: Long-term trend strength bullish
· 52-week position (82.6%) + current price level is a pullback from historical highs
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (62.3→61.2) + neutral sustained, downward momentum
· MACD histogram trajectory (1.1008→0.6448) + worsening, weak trend reversal signal
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band $73.77) + 23.42% band width at normal levels
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($70.96) + basis (pivot/swing low/moving average based)
· Swing Resistance ($79.68) + potential for short-term upward momentum upon breakout
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (early Higher Low) + trend strengthening signal
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.72x) + subdued confidence in movement
· Current phase diagnosis (uptrend) + entry conditions met, waiting may lead to lower buy score
